
{{alias}}( x )
    Returns an iterator which iterates over the Cartesian square of an
    array-like object.

    The Cartesian square is equivalent to the Cartesian product of an
    array-like object with itself.

    The order of the returned tuples follows the order of iteration of the
    provided array-like object, with elements of the second tuple component
    varying fastest.

    If provided an empty array-like object, the returned iterator is empty.

    If an environment supports Symbol.iterator, the returned iterator is
    iterable.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: ArrayLikeObject
        Input array.

    Returns
    -------
    iterator: Object
        Iterator.

    iterator.next(): Function
        Returns an iterator protocol-compliant object containing the next
        iterated value (if one exists) and a boolean flag indicating whether the
        iterator is finished.

    iterator.return( [value] ): Function
        Finishes an iterator and returns a provided value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var it = {{alias}}( [ 1, 2 ] );
    > var v = it.next().value
    [ 1, 1 ]
    > v = it.next().value
    [ 1, 2 ]
    > v = it.next().value
    [ 2, 1 ]

    See Also
    --------
